learning_outcomes.text: Learning the Matlab software package, which is a mathematics-based software package, at a basic level.
Being able to solve basic mathematical problems using the Matlab software package.
Being able to solve engineering problems using the Matlab software package.
Being able to solve engineering problems involving differential equations.
Being able to write programs for solving engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Matlab program and its operating logic; Arranging mathematical expressions in Matlab page
Arrays and numerical solution of simple equations
Variables and constants; Graphs and graph creation
bibliography: Matlab: An Introduction with Applications, Gilat A., 4th ed., John Wiley & Sons, 2010.
Temel Matlab, Daniel T. Valentine, Brian H. Hahn, Nobel (Çev. İbrahim Karatay) Akademik Yayıncılık, 2016.
